title: Minutes until every orange rots
summary: Every rotten orange spoils its neighbours a minute later, like a ripple; count the rings needed to reach every fresh orange.
goal: Count the minutes until no fresh orange is left, or report that one never rots

mapping.story: All rotten oranges at the start
mapping.formal: All sources in the queue at once

examples.label: Rot reaches all
examples.explanation: The ripple needs four minutes to reach the bottom-right orange.

examples.label: One orange is cut off
examples.explanation: The bottom-left orange has no neighbour that can rot it.

examples.label: No fresh oranges
examples.explanation: There is nothing left to rot.

ladder.name: Simulate minute by minute
ladder.idea: Each minute, scan the whole crate and rot every fresh orange next to a rotten one; stop when nothing changes.

ladder.name: One ripple from every rotten orange
ladder.idea: Put every rotten orange in a queue at once. Spread one ring per minute: each orange taken from the queue rots its fresh neighbours and queues them.
ladder.insight: Rescanning the whole crate every minute repeats work. Only oranges that rotted last minute can spread rot this minute, and a queue holds exactly those.

transfer.problem: Several fire stations respond to a city grid. Find the longest time any block waits for the nearest station.
transfer.explanation: Start BFS from all stations at once; the last ring reached gives the longest wait.

selfCheck: Starts with every rotten orange in the queue.
Counts minutes by levels, not by oranges.
Returns −1 if a fresh orange remains.
